## How to Choose a Commercial Cleaning Company in Melbourne

When evaluating commercial cleaning providers in Melbourne, facility managers should verify five critical compliance markers before signing any contract. First, confirm the company holds current ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 certifications audited by a JAS-ANZ-accredited body — not self-declared. Second, request evidence of Cm3 or Rapid Global prequalification, which independently verifies insurance coverage, WHS management systems, and environmental compliance. Third, check that all cleaning products carry GECA certification under ISO 14024, confirming low-VOC and greywater-safe formulations.

Fourth, confirm the contractor directly employs all staff under the Cleaning Services Award 2020 and provides WorkCover Victoria workers’ compensation — this protects your business from accessory liability under the Fair Work Act 2009. Fifth, ask for a sample monthly compliance report that includes ATP bioluminescence audit results, cleaning frequency logs, and chemical safety data sheets. Any reputable commercial cleaning company in Melbourne should provide all five markers without hesitation. Clean Group provides each of these as standard with every contract.
